An '''incident''' occurred during the ceremony of the [[tizo'pil Yun'tchilat]] on a [[Sh'rip Sh'pa|seedship]] in [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]]. Captured [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] led the [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] to rebel, and went on a mission to destroy all of the [[dhuryam]]s, but was stopped by [[Vergere]] before he slew the [[World Brain|last one]].
